title: Decimal holders read the signed value at the selected buffer position
summary: Both Arrow widths and both holder readers recovered the negative decimal regardless of its neighbors. On this little-endian host the parent holder and vector reads disagreed.

change.description: The generated decimal holder readers now decode using native byte order and take the holder’s start as a byte offset. The vector utility also keeps its existing index-based entry.

notes: The measured host is little-endian. The parent prediction depends on byte order.
